name: Opera Bar: Under the Southern Sky
blurb: Arguably the most famous NYE party in the country: a harbourside festival on the Opera House lower concourse, staring straight at the Harbour Bridge.

name: NYE Pier Party at Pier One
venue: Pier One Sydney Harbour, 11 Hickson Rd
price_text: $349 early dinner to $699 late seating; Pier Party $650
blurb: A heritage wharf right under the Harbour Bridge with a party, two dinner seatings and a lounge, so you can pick the price and pace that suits you.

name: Glenmore Hotel Rooftop NYE
includes: Bubbles on arrival and at midnight
Live music, DJ and silent disco
blurb: The Rocks' best-loved rooftop pub, with Opera House and Bridge views and a drinks package that runs most of the night.

name: Cruise Bar & Melba's Rooftop NYE
price_text: GA from $199pp; Melba's Rooftop Premium price on request
includes: Two levels of DJs and entertainment
Premium: 3-hour Veuve Clicquot drinks package 6pm to 9pm
blurb: Right on the water at Circular Quay. One of the cheapest ways to get a front-row harbour view without a cruise.

name: NYE at The Oriana
time: Early seating 5:00pm to 7:00pm; main events from 6:00pm or 8:00pm
fireworks: Fireworks views on later experiences (not early seating)
blurb: Multi-level waterfront venue with tiers from an early canapé session up to a free-flowing Moët room.

name: NYE at MCA Rooftop
venue: Museum of Contemporary Art, Level 6 Harbourside Room
includes: Premium wine, beer and soft drinks
fireworks: Uninterrupted views from the Level 6 rooftop
blurb: A gallery rooftop directly across Circular Quay from the Opera House. Polished, grown-up and very well placed.

name: New Year's Eve at Aria
price_text: 2026 pricing not yet released (join the waitlist)
includes: Six-course tasting menu with wine pairing ($1,950pp)
blurb: Fine dining with floor-to-ceiling views of the Opera House and Bridge. The early sitting is one of the best-value harbour dinners in the city.

name: New Year's Eve at Bennelong
includes: Champagne on arrival and at midnight
blurb: Dinner inside the Opera House's own sails. Few places put you closer to the fireworks.

name: New Year's Eve at Whalebridge
blurb: A sleek harbourfront dining room between the Opera House and the ferry wharves.

name: Bar 83 NYE Disco
price_text: 2026 pricing not yet released (join the waitlist)
blurb: The highest bar in Sydney. You watch the fireworks from above.

name: Zephyr Sky Bar NYE
blurb: Rooftop pool-deck bar above Darling Harbour. Tiered release pricing, so book early.

name: Luna Park NYE Harbour Party
price_text: GA final release $349 (+ fees); Premium VIP Diamond $1,099
includes: GA early releases sold out, final release on sale
blurb: Rides, DJs and a view straight under the Harbour Bridge. It sold out last year, so get on the presale list.

name: View Sydney NYE Soirée
includes: Free-flowing beer, wine, sparkling and Prosecco
blurb: A 17th-floor deck in North Sydney looking back at the Bridge and city skyline.

name: NYE at Sails on Lavender Bay
blurb: Waterside dining in a quiet bay beside the Bridge, looking right at the main barges.

name: NYE at The Botanist
includes: Choice of early or late sitting
fireworks: Not visible from venue (vantage points nearby at Milsons Point)
blurb: A relaxed set-menu dinner a short walk from the Kirribilli foreshore.

name: New Year's Eve at Taronga Zoo
includes: Picnic-style lawn viewing with live music (Silver and Gold)
Premium food and drinks in Taronga Centre tiers
Diamond, Gold, Opal and Platinum sold out
Children 3 and under free on grounds tiers
blurb: Fireworks from the zoo's hillside with the whole city skyline in front of you. One of the few premium options that takes kids.

name: NYE at Ripples Chowder Bay
blurb: A heritage wharf restaurant tucked into Chowder Bay.

name: Watsons Bay Hotel NYE
includes: VIP: food stations and Top Deck harbour views
blurb: A beer garden on the beach at the harbour mouth. Very Sydney.

name: NYE at The Butler
includes: Shared-style feast by Chef Amber Doig
Table reserved for the whole night
blurb: A leafy Potts Point terrace with skyline views and a long, lazy feast.

name: NYE at Otto Ristorante
price_text: $375 per adult main sitting, $120 per child; early sitting à la carte
time: Early sitting 5:00pm to 6:15pm; main sitting from 7:30pm
includes: Semi-private Wool Lift for 10 to 14 guests
blurb: A Finger Wharf institution. Long Italian dinners in a buzzy room.

name: elrow Sydney XXL Bondi Beach
includes: Meduza (Australian exclusive), Kölsch, Arielle Free and more
VIP: promenade area in front of stage with its own bar
elrow x Field Day New Year's Day bundle available
blurb: The first big NYE party on Bondi Beach in over a decade, from the people behind the famously over-the-top elrow.

name: NYE at The Fenwick
blurb: A sandstone harbourfront venue in Balmain East with a western view of the Bridge.

name: Starship Sydney NYE Cruise
includes: 5.5-hour cruise inside the fireworks exclusion zone
Moët, wines and Young Henrys beer
blurb: A big, sleek glass ship that gets you right in among the fireworks barges.

name: Clearview Glass Boat NYE Cruise
blurb: A luxury all-glass boat with the longest itinerary on the harbour.

name: Coast Premium NYE Cruise
includes: About 6 hours on the harbour from King Street Wharf
blurb: A capped-capacity catamaran party, so the deck never gets crowded.

name: Wirawi NYE Cruise
blurb: A First Nations-run cruise company that puts culture alongside the celebration.

name: Lower Bradfield Park Ticketed Vantage
includes: Entry to harbourside vantage point (gates close 9pm)
Food for sale, BYO food allowed
blurb: Possibly the best $65 you'll spend in Sydney: a picnic rug almost directly under the Bridge.

name: Blues Point Reserve Ticketed Vantage
includes: Entry to Blues Point vantage point (gates close 9pm)
Food for sale, BYO food allowed
blurb: The view from the postcards: the Bridge and Opera House lined up together.

name: Dudley Page Reserve Ticketed Vantage
includes: Live DJ, roving entertainment and silent disco
Kids zone, lawn games and face painting
age: All ages (under 18s with a ticketed adult)
blurb: A grassy hilltop with a long-range view of the whole skyline lighting up.

name: Sydney Opera House Forecourt (free ticketed)
includes: Guaranteed entry to the Opera House Forecourt
blurb: A free ticket for a world-famous view. Be online at 10am on 26 December, because they go in minutes.

name: Goat Island (free ticketed)
includes: BYO picnic and alcohol (no food sold)
blurb: Watch from an island in the middle of the harbour, with no crowds.

name: Studio '27 at the Yallamundi Rooms
blurb: A disco-themed party inside the Opera House's Yallamundi Rooms, with the midnight fireworks just outside the windows. Tickets are non-refundable.

name: New Year's Eve at the Opera: Opera Gala and La Boheme
price_text: Shows from $249; dinner or midnight party $499 each; Platinum Package $1,956
time: Performances 7:45pm; dinner 5:30pm; midnight party after the show
includes: Opera Gala Concert or La Boheme
Optional three-course pre-show dinner with wines
Optional midnight party in the Northern Foyers
blurb: Opera Australia stages the Opera Gala and a new La Boheme, with the interval timed to the 9pm fireworks. Dinner and midnight party packages in the harbour-facing Northern Foyers are sold separately.

name: New Year's Eve at Altitude
venue: Altitude, Level 36, Shangri-La Sydney, 176 Cumberland St
includes: Opera House and Harbour Bridge views
blurb: An eight-course degustation with matched wines on level 36 of the Shangri-La, looking over the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. A window table costs extra.

name: Golden Hour to Midnight at Blu Bar on 36
venue: Blu Bar on 36, Shangri-La Sydney, 176 Cumberland St
blurb: A standing cocktail party in the Shangri-La's level 36 bar with open views over the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. Seating is limited.

name: New Year's Eve at Infinity by Mark Best
venue: Infinity by Mark Best, Sydney Tower, 100 Market St
price_text: Bar session $499; dining $1,040 to $1,490 per person
blurb: A five-course dinner by Mark Best inside Sydney Tower, 261 metres up. A cheaper late bar session runs from 10pm with free-flowing drinks.

name: Celebrate NYE at Harbour Rocks
venue: Harbour Rocks by Ode Hotels, 34 Harrington St
blurb: A cocktail party in the hotel's Harbour View Suite with a view of the midnight fireworks. The Ultimate package adds an early dinner at Tayim.

name: Mac's New Year's Eve Party
blurb: An Irish pub party in The Rocks with a drinks package, canapés and live music. Guests watch both fireworks from George Street outside.

name: The Midnight Hour at The Doss House
blurb: A whisky bar party in a heritage basement in The Rocks, with a three-hour drinks package and live music. Guests head to George Street for both fireworks.

name: New Year's Eve and Fireworks at Jounieh
blurb: A Lebanese banquet at Dawes Point with two seatings, one for the 9pm fireworks and one for midnight, watched from the pier out front.

name: Celebration at the End of the Wharf
venue: The Wharf Restaurant and Bar, Pier 4, Hickson Rd
includes: Three ticket tiers including Wharf Club VIP
blurb: A white dress code party at the end of Pier 4 in Walsh Bay, with viewing areas for both fireworks.

name: Elements NYE on the Harbour
venue: Elements Bar and Grill Walsh Bay, 23 Hickson Rd
blurb: An eight-course dinner and party on a Walsh Bay wharf with private fireworks viewing. Only the top Celebration package includes drinks.

name: New Year's Eve Buffet at Amora Hotel Jamison
venue: Amora Hotel Jamison Sydney, 11 Jamison St
fireworks: No view; the harbour is a five-minute walk
blurb: A hotel buffet near Wynyard, a five-minute walk from harbour viewing spots. One of the cheapest sit-down dinners in the city.

name: New Year's Eve at Q Station
venue: The Hospital Precinct, Q Station, 1 North Head Scenic Dr
blurb: A dinner party in the old Quarantine Station hospital precinct on North Head, with views across the water to the midnight fireworks.

name: Captain Cook Sydney 2000 NYE Dinner Cruise
venue: MV Sydney 2000, Captain Cook Cruises, King Street Wharf 1
includes: Four to six-course dinner by deck
fireworks: From inside the fireworks exclusion zone
blurb: Captain Cook's flagship dinner cruise sits inside the harbour exclusion zone for the night. The top Sky Deck tier serves a six-course degustation with Penfolds wines.

name: NYE on the Tall Ship James Craig
venue: Tall Ship James Craig, Australian National Maritime Museum
includes: Sails in front of the Harbour Bridge
blurb: Sydney Heritage Fleet sails its restored 1874 tall ship in front of the Harbour Bridge for both fireworks.

name: Glass Island New Year's Eve Cruise
blurb: A party boat from King Street Wharf with a drinks package, canapés and Moët for the midnight fireworks.

name: NYE Harbour Cruise on Aussie Magic
blurb: An all-inclusive catamaran cruise for up to 130 adults. Spirits are sold at a cash bar.

name: NYE All-Inclusive Cruise on Karisma 2
blurb: A two-level, smoke-free boat for 150 guests with indoor lounges and outdoor decks.

name: NYE All-Inclusive Cruise on Zahara
blurb: An all-inclusive cruise for up to 100 guests. Spirits are sold at a cash bar.

name: Eclipse NYE Cruise
blurb: A multi-level catamaran for up to 200 guests, cocktail style with no reserved seating, inside the exclusion zone.

name: Exclusive NYE Cruise on Ariston
blurb: An 80ft luxury motor yacht with a personal chef and waitstaff on board.

name: Small Group NYE Cruise on Silver Spirit
blurb: A 60ft motor yacht limited to 40 guests that cruises inside the exclusion zone between shows.

name: NYE on SEADECK
blurb: A party vessel that joins the light parade for exclusion zone access. Seating is shared, first in first served.

name: The Jackson NYE Luxury Cocktail Cruise
venue: The Jackson Superyacht, King Street Wharf 1
blurb: A superyacht cocktail cruise with six hours of drinks and roaming food stations.

name: NYE aboard Steam Tug Waratah
blurb: A BYO cruise on a 1902 steam tug from the Heritage Docks in Rozelle. Paper or plastic cups only.

name: NYE aboard Steam Launch Lady Hopetoun
blurb: A BYO night on a 1902 VIP steam launch departing the Heritage Docks in Rozelle.

name: NYE on the Harbour All-Inclusive Cruise (LeBleu)
blurb: A 200-guest party cruise with indoor, outdoor and open-air viewing areas.

name: Inception Lux NYE Fireworks Cruise
includes: Beer, wine, champagne and house spirits
blurb: A three-level all-inclusive vessel positioned inside the exclusion zone.

name: Bella Vista New Year's Eve Cruise
blurb: A multi-level glass vessel cruise. Check the boarding wharf before booking.

name: NYE 9pm Family Fireworks Cruise (Fantasea)
blurb: A short family cruise from Darling Harbour for the early fireworks. Fantasea also runs 9pm cruises from Manly and Double Bay.

name: NYE Midnight Fireworks Cruise (Fantasea)
blurb: A two-and-a-half-hour late cruise for the midnight show. Some vessels have sold out.

name: Double Bay NYE Fireworks Cruise
price_text: 9pm cruise from $395; midnight cruise $695, BYO food
blurb: Separate 9pm and midnight fireworks cruises from Double Bay Wharf. The midnight cruise leaves at 10:30pm.

name: New Year's Eve at Clark Island
venue: Clark Island, Sydney Harbour National Park
blurb: A harbour island picnic reached by ferry from Rose Bay. No food or drink is sold, and it is currently booked out.

name: New Year's Eve on Shark Island
venue: Shark Island, Sydney Harbour National Park
blurb: A grassed island about 1km off Rose Bay, reached by ferry, with no food sold. Currently booked out.

name: New Year's Eve at Bradleys Head
venue: Bradleys Head, Sydney Harbour National Park
includes: Amphitheatre, Mast Precinct and Athol Lawn
Food and soft drinks for sale
blurb: Free ticketed headland viewing on the northern foreshore with three viewing areas. Currently booked out.

name: New Year's Eve at Strickland Estate
venue: Strickland Estate, Sydney Harbour National Park
price_text: Free ticket (booked out; general entry may open from 6pm)
includes: Early entry 5pm to 6pm for ticket holders
General access from 6pm if not full
Licensed, glass free, food for sale
blurb: Harbourside lawns in Vaucluse with some direct Harbour Bridge views.

name: NYE on the Cahill Expressway
price_text: Free (ballot closed; winners notified by 4 Dec)
includes: Free ballot tickets for NSW residents
Road-top view between the Opera House and Bridge
blurb: A Transport for NSW ballot for a road-top view between the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. The ballot has closed.

name: Foundation & Friends NYE Picnic, Royal Botanic Garden
venue: Mare and Foal Lawn, Royal Botanic Garden Sydney
blurb: A members' picnic on a garden lawn facing the Opera House and Harbour Bridge. Members and their guests can book.
